name: P09
title: COPD Exacerbation Management
description: The patient undergoes respiratory observation and SpO₂ monitoring. If abnormal findings are detected, the practitioner is alerted as soon as possible. Bronchodilator medication is administered. The patient receives education on correct inhaler use and daily self-management strategies.

fhir_actions.label: The patient undergoes respiratory observation
